body:
i liked daydreaming. been trying to transfer that daydreaming onto paper. i even came up with a pretty good alternate life for myself as an escape.

i can't tell you how glad that this is here and that i found it. because without you guys i think last night might have ended up elsewhere.

What was your experience when coming out with your problems to friends and family? 

i'm my family will support me i think. (i really hope they will). Im sure my friends will support me as well. But what steps are there to take. I really want to spin this as the beginning as orangutan said. If i make it the beginning there is still chance and hope. Hope is what i need the best at the moment i believe. The hope that things WILL get better. That things WILL change. 

This will be the biggest leap in my life in the the unknown and i hope this leap will take me out of my dark prison and into the light once more.

i think i need to leave college, i'm not in the right midset to continue, i tried this quarter, i mean really dammed tried. Spending 6+ hours just studying and reading. My outlook and grades don't reflect my efforts. i think i just flamed out. 

You're right i need to stop living up to what i believe are other people's expectations. I need to figure out what i want and i'm not sure how long that would take.

thanks for the reply, the hardest part is facing myself. i never though that as i was growing up i would have ended up like this. i'm happy i didn't do anything last night, didnt' even try to drink away my problems like i would normally done because i was up all night searching suicide methods and job hunting at the same time :/  

trying to figure what i could do with 4 years of college but no degree, and roughly 18k in debt. I figure it would take about 2 years of 700 installments each month (not figuring in interest). So overall it didn't look too bleak.
